status: bounded current-service evidence; no disposition, owner, hold, qualification, repair, or acceptance change

query.pace: one sequential request per exact held center with 1.0 second delay
query.response_handling: The in-memory text/plain response was reduced to selected non-geometric identification attributes (feature IDs, names, location type, CUATM and parent codes); response bodies were discarded. Geometry arrays and extents were not retained.

query_window.note: The GetFeatureInfo center pixel represents roughly 10 x 15 m at these latitudes; service metadata states 10–20 m precision. This pixel/precision scale is comparable to the measured MDA full-versus-simplified boundary offsets, not a tighter survey tolerance.

official_service_binding.conditions: service metadata states no fee/access constraint; underlying dataset reuse conditions remain unknown
official_service_binding.dataset_lineage: initial cartography 2002–2005, updates since 2014 from boundary-establishment files; no per-feature validity date/exact 2020 snapshot/source link to consumed geoBoundaries release

decision_assessment.what_it_adds: For 108/133 centers, the current service identifies an MDA UAT whose normalized name matches the original target name; it supplies independent current name/location corroboration for those centers. For 25 centers it returns no feature; 20 of these are among the 68 UKR-contact group, and 5 among the 65 MDA-only group. No returned current name contradicts the original target.
decision_assessment.what_it_does_not_resolve: The service is revised in 2026 and says boundaries are updated since 2014, but gives no per-feature valid-time or linkage to the consumed 2020 MDA source. GetFeatureInfo returns attributes at a roughly 10x15m pixel, not an inspectable boundary; the stated 10–20m service precision is comparable to the 65-key source-version offsets. It therefore cannot distinguish which 2020 MDA representation governs, establish exact side-of-boundary for near-edge points, or resolve UKR/MDA source applicability. No-feature is not negative membership because service coverage/representation is unknown for those locations.
decision_assessment.conclusion: Useful bounded current-label corroboration, but not sufficient to close or reclassify the source-version or cross-source groups. Keep unresolved questions per key/class; do not convert the absence of exact 2020 lineage into a blanket extra requirement.

limits: This is current administrative service evidence, not a reconstruction of the consumed 2020 MDA or UKR source.
The service does not expose cell-specific boundary validity or a source link to the consumed MDA release.
The query uses the center pixel and no extra geographic tolerance/buffer; the pixel footprint itself is approximately 10 x 15 m.
The 25 no-feature results show only that the service returned no queried feature; they do not establish absence from the administrative territory.
No geometry or raw response body is retained or published.
All 133 original pending cells, original interval/owner denominators, and holds remain unchanged.
